PLAN "3-Week Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Return to pre-illness strength levels"

PHASES
  PHASE "Week 1 — Reintroduction" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body A — Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Full Body B — Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          quad_stretch 60s
          chest_stretch 60s

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body C — Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          forward_fold 60s

  PHASE "Week 2 — Progressive Loading" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Full Body A — Progressive Loading":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..40 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s

      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Full Body B — Progressive Loading":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          quad_stretch 60s
          chest_stretch 60s

      DAY Friday training 55m "Full Body C — Progressive Loading":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          forward_fold 60s

  PHASE "Week 3 — Strength Return" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full Body A — Strength Return":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4..5 rpe 7..8 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 4x4..5 rpe 7..8 rest 180 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s

      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Full Body B — Strength Return":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..4 rpe 7..8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60s
          quad_stretch 60s
          chest_stretch 60s

      DAY Friday training 60m "Full Body C — Strength Return":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x3..4 rpe 7..8 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          forward_fold 60s
